name: warming_trend_pre_cool_revised_away_1378
description: Control for warming_trend_pre_cool_applied: the same warming-trend night (14:00 classification today 80/62F, tomorrow 95/77F, setback_modifier -3.0, so the 02:30 pre-cool is decided in the evening), but the forecast is revised overnight: the 00:00 reclassification says the day the night wakes into is 82/62F. At 02:30 production's own trigger re-checks the night on that day (#1378): no warming trend (+1F against the recorded 80/62F) and not hot (82 < 85), so the AC is not run for heat that is no longer coming. The sleep ceiling stays 72F and nothing is written at 02:30.
notes: Same config and evening as warming_trend_pre_cool_applied (the positive sibling); only the 00:00
reclassification differs. Defaults: DEFAULT_SLEEP_COOL=72, DEFAULT_SLEEP_HEAT=64; wake 06:30 -> trigger 02:30.
_maybe_schedule_pre_cool() decides the night waking 07-17: PreCoolDecision(modifier -3.0, prev_high 80,
Overnight revision, modelled the way production receives it: the weather entity's forecast changes and the
coordinator's next cycle (the first after midnight) reclassifies onto the new day. The scenario hand-feeds
which revises the weather entity to 82/62 at 23:59:30 and asserts no pre-cool event.)
02:30 fire-time re-check (resolve_pre_cool_modifier_for_night, night wakes into today 07-17):
trend gate: ((82-80) + (62-62)) / 2 = +1 < TREND_THRESHOLD_MODERATE (5) -> no trend modifier;
hot gate: today_high 82 < threshold_hot 85 -> no. Neither holds -> 'Pre-cool trigger fired: skipped'.
Assertions are on the thermostat (action_log), not on an event label: no set_temperature after the 00:00
reclassification (which re-sends the unchanged 72F ceiling) through 02:30, and the last setpoint told is still 72F.
use_coordinator: true so Tier A runs the coordinator's own 02:30 trigger and its re-check, as real HA does.
Scenario effectiveness: if the fire-time re-check is removed (the trigger uses the evening's decision as is,
or the re-check always returns the decided modifier), the trigger writes 69F at 02:30 and both 02:30 rows fail.

events.note: Strong warming trend classification: today 80/62F, tomorrow 95/77F, avg_delta +15F -> setback_modifier -3.0. The pre-cool for the night waking 07-17 is decided now, recording 80/62F as the base for the 02:30 re-check.
Evening temperatures — AC holding indoor near comfort_cool.
Bedtime: normal sleep band [64/72] applied. Pre-cool fires separately at 02:30.

Forecast revised overnight: the coordinator's first cycle after midnight reclassifies onto the new day from the updated weather forecast, which now says 82/62F (was 95/77F at 14:00), then 75/60F. Classifier: day_type warm (82 >= 75, < 85); trend to 07-18 ((75-82)+(60-62))/2 = -4.5F, cooling below TREND_THRESHOLD_MODERATE, setback_modifier 0.

Production's own pre-cool trigger fires (wake_time 06:30 - 4h fallback) and re-checks the night on the day it wakes into (#1378): warming trend from the recorded 80/62F to today's 82/62F is +1F (below 5), and today_high 82 < threshold_hot 85, so neither gate holds and the trigger skips. indoor=76.5F as in the applied sibling. Nothing is written.

assertions.reason: Bedtime sleep band [64/72], as in the applied sibling: the evening is identical, the pre-cool has not fired.

Nothing is written by the 02:30 trigger (or after the 00:00 reclassification's re-send of the unchanged 72F sleep ceiling): the trigger skips. A pre-cool that ignored the revised forecast would write 69F here.
The thermostat is still told the 72F sleep ceiling at 02:30: the occupant sleeps at their normal ceiling and the AC is not run to bank cold for a hot day the forecast no longer predicts.

verdict.summary: Pre-cool decided in the evening on a +15F warming trend is dropped at 02:30 when the overnight forecast revision leaves neither a warming trend into the waking day nor a hot day; the sleep ceiling stays 72F
verdict.observed_behavior: classification_applied -> setback_applied (72F sleep ceiling) -> 00:00 reclassification (82/62F, re-sends 72F) -> 02:30 trigger skipped; no setpoint write at 02:30
verdict.expected_behavior: The #1378 fire-time re-check judges the night on the fresh forecast for the day it wakes into; a forecast revised so neither gate holds drops the night's pre-cool (docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md, Issue #1378).
